note: Live paper experiments. Settings are the ones the walk-forward research chose in its most recent fold (research/report.json, 2026-10-18). None of these showed a validated edge; they run to collect live evidence, not because they're expected to win.

experiments.description: EMA trend experiment: hold BTC while the 48h EMA is above the 168h EMA
experiments.research_note: Unseen Jul 2025 - Oct 2026: -23.1% (BTC -23.1%), max drawdown -43.1%, 47 trades, beat BTC in 4 of 5 quarters

experiments.description: Breakout experiment: buy a new 7-day high, sell on a new 3-day low
experiments.research_note: Unseen Jul 2025 - Oct 2026: -13.1% (BTC -23.1%), max drawdown -34.7%, 36 trades, beat BTC in 2 of 5 quarters

experiments.description: Dip-buy experiment: buy when RSI drops below 25 in an uptrend, sell when it recovers above 60
experiments.research_note: Unseen Jul 2025 - Oct 2026: -1.9% (BTC -23.1%), max drawdown -3.9%, only 4 trades in 15 months, mostly in cash
